title: Starlight Glide
theme: A luminous moth-like creature glides through a starlit canyon, collecting glowing starlight crystals while dodging falling rocks and shadow tendrils.
mechanics: Auto-scrolling endless runner with three lanes
Move up and down between lanes to dodge obstacles
Collect starlight crystals for points and speed boosts
Speed increases over time, spawning accelerates
Crash into an obstacle to end the game

controls.action: Jump to a lane by clicking or touching
